title: Reading one positive-result update
description: You can identify the numerator and normalizing terms in the supplied probability calculation.

steps.description: You set prior pi to 0.01 and both Se and Sp to 0.95. These are the fixed inputs for this model calculation.
Se times pi forms the numerator. The denominator adds the positive-result contribution from the complementary case.

steps.question: How many decimal places will this print display?
steps.answer: It displays three decimal places because the format uses .3f.

steps.description: You see Posterior probability given positive test: 0.161. The value comes from the supplied prior and test parameters in this single update.
